questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of Asha and Lata is 5 : 6. If the difference between their ages is 6 years, then what will be Lata’s age after 5 years?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

The ratio of present ages of Asha and Lata = 5 : 6

Let the ages of Asha and Lata be 5x and 6x respectively.

Difference between their ages is 6 years

6x – 5x = 6

x = 6

Then,

Asha’s age, 5x = 5 × 6 = 30

Lata’s age, 6x = 6 × 6 = 36

Lata’s age after 5 years = 36 + 5 = 41

Lata’s age after 5 years is ‘41’

Hence, “41” is the correct answer.

questions.q:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

1. Some animals are elephants.

2. Some elephants are tigers.

Conclusions:

I. Some animals are tigers.

II. No tiger is an animal.
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.solution:
Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

Drawing the Venn diagram for the given statements,



Conclusion 1: Some animals are tigers → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion 2: No tiger is an animal → False (Possible but not definite)

But,

The given conclusions form a complementary pair.

Hence, “either conclusion 1 or conclusion 2” follow.

Note:

Conditions of Either-or case:

1. The elements should be the same in both the statements.

2. Individually both the conclusions should be false.

3. One conclusion should be positive and one conclusion should be negative (Complementary pair)

The two complementary pairs are:

1) All + Some not

2) No + Some

Additional Information

questions.q: Which of these institutions fixes the Repo Rate and the Reverse Repo Rate in India?
options: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4:

• Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is responsible for fixing Repo or Reverse Repo Rate.

• RBI regulates these rates as a part of its monetary policy.

• Monetary policy refers to the steps undertaken by the central bank to control the liquidity and supply of money in the market.

• Repo Rate: It is an Acronym for the Repurchasing Agreement Rate. It is the rate at which RBI lends money to other banks in the country for the short term.

• Reverse Repo Rate: When banks deposit their surplus funds with RBI for a short term, the rate then offered by RBI is called Reverse Repo Rate.

• RBI was nationalized in 1949.

questions.q: If the length of a rectangle is increased by 40%, and the breadth is decreased by 20%, then the area of the rectangle increases by x%. Then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
Short trick:

Area increased by = 40 - 20 - [(40 × 20)/100] = 20 - 8 = 12%

Detailed method:

Let the length and breadth of the rectangle be 10 unit each.

Area of the rectangle = lb = 10 × 10 = 100 sq. unit

New increased length = 10 × (40/100) = 14 unit

New decreased length = 10 × (80/100) = 8 unit

New area of the rectangle = 14 × 8 = 112

Area increased by = 112 - 100 = 12

∴ Area increased by (in %) = (12/100) × 100 = 12%

questions.q:
Select the indirect narration of the given sentence.

He said to the hotel receptionist, “Can you tell me the tariff of rooms?
options: He enquired the hotel receptionist if he can tell him the tariff of rooms.
He asked the hotel receptionist if he could tell him the tariff of rooms.
He asked the hotel receptionist that if he can tell him the tariff of rooms
He asked the hotel receptionist to tell him the tariff of rooms.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is He asked the hotel receptionist if he could tell him the tariff of rooms.

Key Points

• ​We make changes in tenses of reported speech only when the reporting verb is in the past tense.

• When the reported speech is an interrogative sentence we follow these steps-

• Reporting verb 'said' is changed into 'asked'.

• connector 'if' or 'whether' is used in place of commas.

• Change the sentence, given in the reported speech, from interrogative to assertive.

• Tense of reported speech is changed accordingly. ( in above sentence- 'can' changes into 'could')

• personal Pronouns of reported speech are changed as per subject and object of reporting verb. Here, the Second person- 'You' will change into 'he' as per object - 'me' (hidden).

• By following these steps we get the final sentence - *" He asked the hotel receptionist if he could tell him the tariff of rooms."*

Thus, the correct answer is option 2.

The correct answer is option 1 i.e. CBDA

The first statement, C introduces us to the topic at hand - the definition of growth, this is followed by statement B which explains the change that is referred to in statement C. Then comes statement D which then goes into deeper detail about the changes mentioned in the previous statements. Then comes the final statement, A which talks there is another factor that has to be taken into consideration.

Thus, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.q:
Select the passive form of the given sentence.

The manager keeps the work pending.
options: The work are being kept pending by the manager.
The work was kept pending by the manager.
The work has been kept pending by the manager
The work is kept pending by the manager.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is The work is kept pending by the manager.

Key Points

• The instructions given below should be followed while changing an assertive sentence to passive voice.

• Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases.

• Use preposition by before the agent. (the manager)

• Use an appropriate helping verb in passive form according to the tense of the active form. (Present indefinite - is/am/are+ V3)

• Always use the third form of the main verb in passive form.

• At last line up the remaining part.

So, the final sentence is - *The work is kept pending by the manager.*

* Additional Information*

• The voice of the sentence should be changed according to the following rules:

Tense

Active

Passive

Simple Present

Subject + V1 + Object

Object + is/am/are + V3 + by + Subject

Simple Past

Subject + V2 + Object

Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject

Simple Future

Subject + shall/will + V1 + Object

Object + shall/will + be + V3 + by + Subject

Present Continuous

Subject + is/am/are + V1-ing + Object

Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject

Past Continuous

Subject + was/were + V1-ing + Object

Object + was/were + being + V3 + by + Subject

Future Continuous

Subject + shall/will + be + V1-ing + Object

Not possible

Present Perfect

Subject + has/have + V3 + Object

Object + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject

Past Perfect

Subject + had + V3 + Object

Object + had + been + V3 + by + Subject

Future Perfect

Subject + shall/will + have + V3 + Object

Object + shall/will + have + been + V3 + by + Subject

Infinitive

to + base form of verb

to + be + V3

questions.q:
Select the word, which means the same as the groups of words given.

A song sung at a burial
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Dirge.

Key Points

• Dirge: Refers to a song that is sung, lamenting for the dead, especially at their funeral.​

*Thus, the correct answer is option 2.*

Additional Information

Let's look at the meaning of other words:

• Hymn: Refers to a religious song sung in the praise of God.

• Ballad: Refers to a short story that is narrated using short stanzas.

• Sonnet: Refers to a single stanza poem
